title: Hcy Accumulation and SAH Inhibition in Yeast and Drosophila
summary: This cluster revolves around the accumulation of Hcy and SAH in yeast and Drosophila, and their relationship to cardiovascular remodeling. Hcy accumulation is associated with growth defects in yeast strains Canton-S and w[1118], while SAH accumulation is linked to the inhibition of SAHH. SAHH, encoded by the Δsah1 gene, causes growth defects in yeast and Drosophila. The cluster also includes various analytical tools and methods used to study these organisms, such as NMR, Precellys 24 tissue homogenizer, and Agilent 1260 HPLC Infinity system.
